description: Remove an effect from a clip by its index or name. Returns a capability error when the host cannot remove an individual component.

effect_index.description: Index of the effect to remove (0-based). Use get_clip_properties to see effects list.

effect_name.description: Name of the effect to remove (alternative to effect_index)

name: remove_effect

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Remove Effect
